name: Vimeo Player
description: Integrates the Vimeo Player SDK to embed and control Vimeo videos.
project_description:
This module integrates with Vimeo Player SDK . It helps you to embed, and customize displaying Vimeo videos with advanced functionality. This module provides a robust set of tools for developers and content creators to enhance video playback experiences, including tracking various player events.

 Features 
 
 Use various options to embed vimeo videos. 
 Track various player events. 
 Integration with the ECA module
